FRONT SUSPENSION
33A-6
ON-VEHICLE SERVICE
FRONT WHEEL ALIGNMENT CHECK AND 
ADJUSTMENT
M1331000900080
Required Special Tool:
• MB991004: Wheel Alignment Gauge Attachment.
Measure wheel alignment with alignment equipment on a level 
surface. The front suspension, steering system, and wheels 
should be serviced to normal condition before measuring wheel 
alignment.
TOE-IN
Standard value: 0 ± 3 mm (0 ± 0.12 inch)
NOTE: If the toe-in is not within the standard value, adjust the 
toe-in by undoing the clips and turning the left and right tie rod 
turnbuckles by the same amount (in opposite directions).
NOTE: The toe will move out as the left turnbuckle is turned 
toward the front of the vehicle and the right turnbuckle is turned 
toward the rear of the vehicle.
For each one turn of the left and right tie rods, the toe-in will be 
adjusted by approximately 1°05' (per wheel).
